parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

>  You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain the ID of the check item.

parameters.name: DimensionType
parameters.description:
The dimension of the task that you want to submit. Valid values:

*   Instance dimension: INSTANCE
*   Check item dimension: CHECK_ID

parameters.name: OperationTaskInstances
parameters.description: The asset information required to submit the tasks for instances.

parameters.name: RelationKey
parameters.description:
The key linked to cross-page selections during task submission.

>  You can call the [CreateAssetSelectionConfig](~~CreateAssetSelectionConfig~~) operation to query the associated key from the BusinessType field.

parameters.name: RepairTempParam
parameters.description: The temporary parameters required for the repair task.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the task that you want to submit. Valid values:

*   Repair task: REPAIR
*   Rollback task: ROLLBACK

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas submit-operation-task --check-id 132 --operation-task-instances TaskId=7d0b10e35e80c9e5ebac5f10540000 InstanceId=i-uf6533m4vuo3oa330000 Vendor=7 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --dimension-type CHECK_ID --type REPAIR --repair-temp-param Value=192.168.1XX.1XX Name=IPPort --relation-key CSPM_OPERATION_RELATION_KEY_173000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
